text:
Type: folk-print rectangular cushion with tassels
Use: back support and a bright accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: printed cotton fabric, cotton tassels at the corners
Colors: white, red, coral, light blue, mustard yellow, green, black
Shape: long rectangle, all-over pattern of stylized flowers, leaves, birds and a leaping deer, a dark red tassel on each corner, softly filled, compact
Feel: cheerful, playful, lively, crafted
Goes with: white or grey sofas, warm wood, rattan, red or green accents; bohemian, folk or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: RDARV
product.description: Embroidery adds texture and lustre to the cushion.
